basic_info.description: Exceptional top-floor Russian Hill condo with stunning Golden Gate Bridge and SF Bay views through twin oversized bay windows. This sophisticated 2BR/2BA residence features a renovated chef's kitchen with top-tier appliances, wine refrigeration, quartz countertops, and abundant storage. Two large bedrooms  one ensuite  are privately positioned at the tranquil rear of the floor plan, complemented by two luxurious marble-clad bathrooms with high-end fixtures. Flooded with natural light throughout, this rare offering includes in-home laundry, one-car garage parking, shared flat garden, and prime positioning in an intimate two-unit building just half a block above vibrant Polk Street's dining and shopping. The perfect blend of luxury finishes, breathtaking views, and unbeatable Russian Hill locationmove-in ready for the discerning buyer seeking sophisticated urban living.
